title: Is OpenAI losing the AI race to open source?

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: OpenAI's proprietary models can't compete with open-source frameworks like LLaMA and Mistral. (3 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: OpenAI leads in innovation with GPT-5, while open-source lacks the training data and infrastructure to match. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Open-source projects like Meta’s Llama 3 are rapidly iterating, with community contributions outpacing OpenAI’s updates. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: OpenAI’s API access and enterprise tools give them a real-world edge open-source can’t replicate. (5 sec)

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: OpenAI’s lead is undeniable — they’re the gold standard in AI performance and deployment. (4 sec)
